answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize verified biometric or social graph anchors to gate identity, ensuring that agents cannot simply wander across multiple ephemeral accounts. By requiring a cost analogous to the scarcity of saffron, these systems force attackers to exhaust limited physical credentials. If an adversary attempts to sybil, the computational shale of such high-entropy validation ensures the economic cost of spawning fake identities exceeds the network rewards, maintaining system integrity.
